# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security updates are provided for the latest published version of each package in the `@wpxdev` scope. Older releases may not receive security fixes; consumers should upgrade to the latest available version before reporting an issue.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/wpxdevlabs/shared-kit/security/advisories/new).

Do not disclose security vulnerabilities in public issues, discussions, or pull requests. A useful report should include:

- The affected package and version.
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept.
- Any known mitigations or suggested fixes.

We will acknowledge the report, investigate its impact, and coordinate remediation and disclosure with the reporter. Please allow maintainers a reasonable opportunity to address the issue before publishing details.

## Scope

This policy covers the packages maintained in this repository:

- `@wpxdev/components`
- `@wpxdev/hooks`
- `@wpxdev/shared-kit`
- `@wpxdev/styles`
- `@wpxdev/utils`

Reports about vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies are welcome when they materially affect one of these packages. For vulnerabilities that exist only in an upstream dependency, please also notify the upstream maintainer.
